feed.title: NPR Topics: News
feed.subtitle: Breaking news, top national and world stories, politics, business and culture from NPR. Catch up on demand with NPR News Now, Up First and Consider This.

entry.title: Russell Brand to learn sentence after being found guilty of rape and sexual assault
entry.summary: Comedian Brand faces a "significant" prison sentence, which a London court judge is set to hand down on Monday.

entry.title: Climate change is altering the colors we see in the world: an illustrated journey
entry.summary: From Arctic landscapes to insect bodies, climate change is shifting the familiar colors of nature.

entry.title: A desert stirs to life: Chile's Atacama erupts in its biggest floral display in decades
entry.summary: El Niño rains have transformed Chile's Atacama Desert into a spectacular sea of color, awakening a fleeting ecosystem of flowers and wildlife in one of the driest places on Earth.

entry.title: In Maine, a new approach to practicing medicine in the sky
entry.summary: Air medical service comes with high risks, high costs, and staffing struggles. To reduce turnover and serve rural patients, LifeFlight of Maine is putting the needs of healthcare workers first.

entry.title: How Gen Z voters helped fuel a blue wave for Democrats
entry.summary: Republicans made gains with young voters in 2024, but in this year's midterms Americans under 30 issued a strong rebuke of President Trump and his party, voting decisively for Democrats instead.

entry.title: UFC's Dana White says he will meet with Trump Monday over offer to be White House press secretary
entry.summary: President Donald Trump said Saturday that he has offered the job of White House press secretary to his friend and UFC boss Dana White.

entry.title: Homelessness in the U.S. saw its largest drop in more than a decade last year
entry.summary: Homelessness declined after years of record-high levels but it still remains at nearly 700,000. The Trump administration and homeless advocacy groups cite different reasons for the drop.

entry.title: The surprising and often forgotten history of economic populism in Texas
entry.summary: NPR's Rob Schmitz speaks with Austin-based political commentator David Griscom. He authored a book titled The Myth of Red Texas which tells the story of economic populism in Texas.

entry.title: Oklahoma tribes say proposed legal changes put ancestral lands in Ohio at risk
entry.summary: The Trump administration has proposed changes to the National Historic Preservation Act that could endanger historic sites significant to tribal nations across the country. Oklahoma tribes say that puts ancestral lands in Ohio at risk.

entry.title: Israel's president taps opposition candidate, not Netanyahu, to form a government
entry.summary: Gadi Eisenkot ran as the main rival to Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, but neither won enough support to command a majority. Israel's main parties have recommended Eisenkot form a new government.
